origin: Alliant Powder Reloader's Guide 2022, shotshell data (12, 16, 20 and 28 gauge, lead shot; loads, velocities, psi pressures; tools/loaddata)
descr: FOR SHOTSHELLS ONLY (caliber with Shotshell = yes). The burn rate Ba is fitted to 83 published shotgun loads with the shotshell model of the solver (shot column and 2.5 g wad as the projectile, 28 inch barrel; mostly 12 gauge 2 3/4"): velocity error 3.1 % rms, pressure error 14 % rms (pressure varies with wad and primer, which the model does not know). With a rifle or handgun cartridge the value is wrong: use another record of this powder. Not published and therefore only typical values: Qex, k, material and bulk density, form function. Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
